evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce STQA (Stock-focused Tabular Question Answering), an end-to-end benchmark designed to systematically evaluate natural-language question answering over historical data, numerical forecasts, and forecast-based reasoning.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Stock market analysis inherently requires composite reasoning over historical records and future projections, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across isolated tasks.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Built on a large-scale financial dataset, STQA covers 4,417 stocks and contains 31,400 question-answer pairs derived from expert-crafted templates, accompanied by fine-grained intent and slot annotations.
